manual.fluid_pipes.line2: {0}Fluid Pipes are a versatile and efficient method of transporting fluids, unlike moving tanks ore buckets around en masse.{1}
manual.fluid_pipes.line3: Pipe systems will output any fluid input to them across the available ouputs, split evenly.{0}
manual.fluid_pipes.line4: At low pressure, pipe systems will transport fluid slowly. Pressurized fluids output from a {0}Fluid Pump{1} or certain large machines can move much faster.{2}
manual.fluid_pipes.line5: Fluid Pipes will connect to all possible connections when they are placed. The Engineer's Hammer can be used to connect or disconnect fluid pipes from each other and from tanks.{0}
manual.fluid_pipes.line6: Fluid Pipes can be covered with scaffolding. Placing the scaffolding onto a pipe will cover it, and sneaking + rightclicking the pipe will remove it.{0}
manual.fluid_pipes.line7: Additionally, rightclicking a pipe with any dye will color it to allow easy identification. Colored pipes do not connect to newly placed pipes.
